name: US freight brokers and small 3PLs
icp: Independent US freight brokerages and small 3PLs with roughly 3-50 employees, where the owner or VP Ops still makes buying decisions. Moves FTL/LTL, reefer, flatbed or drayage. Ops team works out of email and a TMS.
disqualifiers: Large national brokerages or public companies (e.g. 500+ employees)
Asset-based carriers with no brokerage arm
Load boards, software vendors, factoring companies or directories
Website is a parked page or the business looks closed

pains.pain: Ops staff re-typing load tenders and quote requests from emails and PDFs into the TMS
pains.solution: An email agent that reads tenders (body + PDF/Excel attachments), extracts lanes, dates, equipment and rates, drafts the quote and creates the load in their TMS for one-click approval
pains.evidence_to_look_for: Quote request forms, 'email us your loads', hiring dispatchers/coordinators, high-volume lanes

pains.pain: Carrier check calls and shipper status updates done by phone and manual emails
pains.solution: Automated check-call outreach (SMS/email/voice) and proactive shipper status updates written from tracking data
pains.evidence_to_look_for: Mentions of 24/7 tracking, 'real-time updates', hiring night dispatch or track-and-trace staff

pains.pain: Rate confirmations, BOLs and PODs processed by hand for invoicing
pains.solution: Document pipeline that matches PODs to loads, flags missing paperwork and drafts invoices, cutting days-to-invoice
pains.evidence_to_look_for: Hiring billing/AR staff, factoring mentions, 'quick pay' programs

offer: A 2-4 week pilot that takes one email-heavy workflow (usually tender entry or quoting) off the ops team, running beside their current process with human approval
guarantee: If it doesn't save the team at least 10 hours a week by day 30, they don't pay the monthly fee
mystery_shop: Email or submit the quote form for a realistic lane and measure the response time and quality
Call the main line after 5pm local time and note whether anyone picks up
tone: Direct, practical, uses freight vocabulary correctly (tenders, lanes, rate cons, PODs, check calls). No hype.
